headline: Robinhood Adds Ripple Stablecoin Alongside Existing Token Offerings
summary: Retail brokerage Robinhood will offer Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin to customers later this year despite previously supporting a rival dollar-backed token.
why: Stablecoin integration expands retail cryptocurrency access and transaction utility on digital brokerage platforms.

impacts.name: Robinhood Markets Inc
impacts.why: Expanding digital asset offerings can drive trading volume and user engagement on the platform.
